description: Twelve realistic 2027 breaking-news test events spanning viral frontier model releases, intraday index flash crashes, sovereign bond interventions, grid moratoriums, voice-clone banking dockets, and trivial benchmark gossip across all four deterministic routing verdicts.

events.headline: Federal Reserve and Treasury Announce Emergency Bank Treasury Capital Ratio Carve-Out After 30-Year Bond Auction Tail Hits 6.4 Basis Points
events.summary: Following a weak $44 billion 30-year US Treasury bond auction where primary dealers absorbed 24.8 percent of supply, the Federal Reserve Board issued an emergency interim final rule on FOMC H.4.1 and 12 CFR capital schedules exempting Treasury holdings from large-bank SLR limits through 2031 while CBO net interest projections cross $1.18 trillion, shifting mortgage-rate volatility and real-yield repression onto household savers.
events.source_hint: US Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement Table 9, Federal Reserve H.4.1, and 12 CFR SLR Docket

events.headline: FERC and PJM Impose Emergency Five-Year Grid Moratorium on Unbacked 500-Megawatt AI Campuses as 13-State Household Utility Tariffs Jump 41 Percent
events.summary: A mandatory FERC reliability order, DOE transformer docket, and PJM Base Residual Auction filing require every AI data center above 300 megawatts to finance dedicated nuclear or gas generation through 2035 after substation queues passed 84 months, locking $48 monthly electric bill surcharges and 20-year utility bond debt onto residential ratepayers, mortgage homeowners, and family checking budgets.
events.source_hint: FERC Reliability Order Docket, DOE Grid Deployment Report, SEC Form 8-K Utility Covenants, and PJM Auction Filing
